rule.statement: A co-owner is entitled to obtain the relief of ejectment of a trespasser, and a prayer for a declaration of title is not a must in a vindicatory action if the title is averred and proved.
rule.supporting_quote: As per our law even a co-owner is entitled to obtain the relief of ejectment of a trespasser. However, even though it is proved that plaintiff is a co-owner to the land in schedule A to the plaint, it is not proper to grant the relief in prayer (1) to the plaint when the Plaintiff herself takes up the position that it is a prayer made by mistake.
